step.name: Insert Areas
step.description: Retrieves Living Areas ('Wonen') based on the location of the building in the IFC model from the national registry.

step.name: Insert BBoxes
step.description: Calculate the 3D bounding box for every geometry.

step.name: Insert Projections
step.description: Generate a 2D map projection for every 3D geometry.

step.name: Insert Topological Relations
step.description: Calculates whether every geometry in the building model spatially overlaps with residential ("wonen") planning zones.

step.name: Validate Topological Relations
step.description: Validate that every geometry in the building is fully contained within residential ("wonen") planning zones.

step.name: Validate Height
step.description: Validate that every geometry in the model has a height within the allowed range.
